caption: The drawing depicts a single object that combines the shape of a bird with a mechanical clamp. The upper portion of the object is a stylized bird, featuring an elongated body, pointed beak, and a tail that tapers to a narrow end. The bird's wings and body are decorated with a diamond or cross-hatch pattern. The bird sits atop a post that connects it to the upper, flat plate of a C-clamp. The clamp has a vertical screw with a heart-shaped handle at the bottom, allowing it to be tightened. The entire object is rendered in shades of gray, giving it a metallic appearance. The background is plain and light-colored with some faint yellowish discoloration and a thin diagonal line in the upper left. There is a small inscription reading "James M. Lawson" at the lower right corner.
title: Silver Bird Sewing Holder
